BAMMS REALTY,LLC, a limitedliabilitycompanyorganized andexisting underthelawsoftheStateofNewYork, having its principal office in New York City at c/o Manhattan Beer Distributors LLC, 400WalnutAvenue,Bronx,NewYork10454, as Sublessor (the“Sublessor") and MANHATTANBEERDISTRIBUTORSLLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of NewYork,having its principal office at 400 Walnut Avenue, Bronx, New York 10454,as Sublessee (the“Sublessee") SUBLEASEAGREEMENT Dated as of May 1, 2009 2009 Manhattan Beer Distributors LLC Project Affecting the Landgenerally known by the street address 1080 Leggett Avenue,Bronx, New York Section10,Block2606andLot3 in the County of Bronx, City and State of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A to this Sublease Agreement on the Official TaxMap ofBronx County Record and Return to: HawkinsDelafield&Wood LLP One ChaseManhattanPlaza New York,New York 10005 Attention: Arthur M.Cohen,Esq. 560481.3 032732 AGMT

SUBLEASEAGREEMENT THISSUBLEASEAGREEMENT,madeandenteredintoasofthedateset forth on the cover page hereof (this “Sublease Agreement"), by and between the entity identified as the Sublessor on the cover page hereof, party of the first part, and the entity identified as the Sublessee on the cover page hereof, party of the second part (capitalized terms used in this Sublease Agreement and not defined herein shall have the respective meanings assigned to such terms in the Lease Agreement referred to below): WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,theEnablingActauthorizesandprovidesforthecreationof industrial development agencies in the several counties, cities, villages and towns in the State of New York and empowers such agencies, among other things, to acquire, construct, reconstruct, lease, improve, maintain, equip and furnish land, any building or other improvement, and all real and personal properties, including but not limited to machinery and equipment, deemed necessary in connection therewith,whether or not now in existence or under construction,which shall be suitable for manufacturing, warehousing, research, commercial, civic or industrial purposes, to the end that such agencies may be able to promote, develop, encourage, assist and advance the job opportunities,health,general prosperity and economicwelfare of the people of the State of NewYork and to improve their prosperity and standard of living; and WHEREAS, pursuant to and in accordance with the provisions of the Enabling Act, the Agency was established by the Agency Act for the benefit of the City and the inhabitantsthereof,and WHEREAS,to accomplish the purposes of theAct,the Agency has entered into negotiations with the Sublessor and the Sublessee toinduce such entities to proceed with the Project for the Facility located on that certain lot, piece or parcel of land described in Exhibit A —“Description of the Land"—— attached hereto and made a part hereof, and to include that and WHEREAS,tofacilitate theProject,theAgency,theSublessor and theSublessee have entered into negotiations to enter into a Straight-Lease Transaction within the meaning of the Act pursuant to which (i) the Sublessor has leased theFacility Realty to the Agency pursuant to the CompanyLease Agreement,dated as of even date herewith between theSublessor and the Agency (as the same may be amended or supplemented, the“Company Lease"), (i) the Agency has subleased its interest in the Facility Realty,and leased the Facility Personalty,to the Sublessor pursuant to the Agency Lease Agreement, dated as of even date herewith between the Agency and the Sublessor (as the same may be amended or supplemented, the “Lease Agreement"),and(ii)the Sublessor willsub-sublease theFacilityRealty,andsubleasethe FacilityPersonalty, to the Sublessee pursuant to this Sublease Agreement; and WHEREAS, in furtherance of the Straight-Lease Transaction, the Agency adopted its Inducement Resolution and its Authorizing Resolution inducing and authorizing, 560481.3032732AGMT

2. among other things,theundertaking of theProject and theProject Work,thelease ofthe Facility Realty by the Sublessor to the Agency,the sublease of the FacilityRealty and the lease of the FacilityPersonaltyby theAgencyto theSublessor, and thesub-sublease of theFacilityRealty and the sublease of the Facility Personalty by the Sublessor to the Sublessee; and WHEREAS, the provision by the Agency of Financial Assistance to the Sublessor and the Sublessee through a Straight-Lease Transaction has been determined to be necessary to induce the Sublessee to remain and expand its operations within the City and not otherwise relocate the same outside of the City; and if the Agency does not provide such Financial Assistance, the Sublessee could not feasibly proceed with the Project; and WHEREAS, the cost of the Project is being financed in accordance with the ProjectFinancingPlan;and WHEREAS, this Sublease Agreement is authorized pursuant to Section 8.9 of the Lease Agreement; NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the respective Section 1. Definitions.The following terms shall have the respective meaningsinthisSubleaseAgreement,exceptasthecontextotherwiserequires: ApprovedProject Operations shall mean thewarehousing facilitylocated at 1080 Leggett Avenue, Bronx, New York, for use by the Sublessee in the distribution of beer and otherbeverages. Authorizing Resolution shall mean the resolution of the Agency adopted on which the Agency is a party. Commencement Date shall mean May 7,2009,on which date this Sublease Agreementwas executed and delivered. Event of Default shall have the meaning specified in Section 9 hereof. Facility shall mean, collectively, the Facility Personalty and the Facility Realty. FacilityPersonalty shall mean the Exempt Personalty described inExhibit B— “Description of the Facility Personalty”, together with all repairs, replacements, improvements, substitutions and renewals thereof or therefor, and all parts, additions and accessories incorporated therein or affixed thereto.Facility Personalty shall, in accordance with the provisions of Sections 3.6 and 6.4 of the Lease Agreement, include all property substituted for or replacing items of Facility Personalty and exclude all items of Facility Personalty so substituted for or replaced, and further exclude all items of Facility Personalty removed as provided in Section3.6oftheLeaseAgreement. Facility Realty shall mean, collectively, the Land and the Improvements. 560481.3 032732AGMT

3. Improvements shall mean (i) all buildings, structures, foundations, related facilities,fixtures and other improvements existing on the Commencement Date and erected or situated on the Land;(i) any other buildings,structures,foundations,related facilities,fixtures and otherimprovements constructed orerected on theLand throughout theterm of thisSublease Agreement (including any improvements or demolitions made as part of the Project Work pursuant to Section 3.3 of the Lease Agreement); and (ii) all replacements, improvements, additions, extensions, substitutions, restorations and repairs to any of the foregoing. Inducement Resolution shall mean the resolution of the Agency adopted on April 14, 2009 inducing the Project. Land shall mean that certain lot,piece or parcel of land inSection 10,Block 2606 and Lot 3, generally known by the street address 1080 Leggett Avenue, Bronx, New York, all as more particularly described in Exhibit A — “Description of the Land", together with all easements, rights and interests now or hereafter appurtenant or beneficial thereto; but excluding, however, any real property or interest therein released pursuant to Section 8.10(c) of the Lease Agreement. Organizational Documents shall mean the articles of organization and operating agreement of the Sublessee. Project shall mean the acquisition, renovation and equipping of a warehousing facility, consisting of an approximately 125,600 square foot facility located on an approximately 209,217 square foot parcel of land at 1080 Leggett Avenue, Bronx, NewYork, all for the use by the Sublessee in its operations as a distributor of beer and other beverages. Project Work shall mean (i) the design, construction and/or renovation of the Improvements, including the acquisition of Exempt Materials and Exempt Fixtures, and (ii) the acquisition,whether by title or lease,of the Exempt Personalty and any workrequired toinstall same. Sublease Agreement shall mean this Sublease Agreement, dated as of May 1, 2009, between the Sublessor and the Sublessee, and shall include any and all amendments hereof andsupplementsheretohereaftermadeinconformityherewith. SubleaseExpirationDateshallmeanJune30,2035. Sublessee shall mean Manhattan Beer Distributors LLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, and its successors and assigns; provided, however, that nothing contained in this definition shall be deemed to limit or modify the obligations of theSublessee underSection8. Sublessor shall mean BAMMS Realty, LLC, a limited liability company organized and existing under the laws of the State of New York, and its successors and assigns; provided, however, that nothing contained in this definition shall be deemed to limit or modify the obligations of the Sublessor under Section 8.9 or 8.20 of the Lease Agreement. 560481.3 032732AGMT
